name: pit-mid-switchback shift (minqueue)
source: Generated with minehaulsim 0.10.0 (pypi.org/project/minehaulsim, Apache-2.0): deterministic DES on a constrained road network (rimpull speed-by-grade, direction zones, emergent bunching), seeded parametric mine generator.

generator.scenario: 10 benches x 10.0 m, switchback ramp (2 lane), 4 shovels, 3 dumps, 28 trucks

caveats: Synthetic cycle log (structure-real): the road network, grades, speeds and queueing are simulated physics; the mine itself is generated, not a real operation. Equipment curves are class-representative, not OEM data. No calibration to any specific mine is claimed.
